provenance: Original procedural gear, geometry and project material swatches. All public images are rendered game GLBs. MIT. No external models, images or fitted references.
method: A new equipment draw uses an independent integer seed and keeps existing body parts. Native hardware offscreen depth plus sampled embedded GLB atlas. 128px role panels; frontal yaw +58 and opposite -58 degrees, elevation 13. First panel rest, second Walk at 0.25 if available. The second and final blind sheets use matching physical scale across each pair. A single independent visual model supplied roles and confidence. Repeated bodies across reviews; tests are exploratory. A near-strong answer is included only in correct, not strict-strong.

results.first: 9/12 clear first-choice correct, five strict strong; two uncertain and one wrong.
results.second: 13/14 first-choice correct, seven strict strong, one uncertain leaning correct.
results.last: 11/12 first-choice correct and five correct strict strong. Couriers 5/5, four leans and one near-strong; traders 2/2 strong; bare 3/3, two strong; observers 1/2, one strong. Seed 8821 was called bare.
results.transfer: Fresh 8820–8827 produced two survey kits and six bare animals. Both first eligible bare walkers given the same explicit courier request, 8822 and 8823, were recognized with lean confidence; these are separate from the ordinary roll.
results.mechanical: 15 loaded exports, 149 gear-to-parent pairs tested at rest and Walk 0, .25, .5, .75. All 745 combinations have at least one non-coplanar triangle intersection. A separate gear-vs-arm/wing check excluded structural harnesses, included the decorative sling, and exposed the listed sling intersections. Leg clipping, additional poses and all frames of the game clips were not exhaustively assessed.
